name: Ávila (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with the arms of the city of Ávila (the apse of the cathedral with a boy king on red, inscribed ÁVILA DEL REY, DE LOS LEALES, DE LOS CABALLEROS).
history: The flag used by the city consists of its arms on a purple field; during the Peninsular War the regiment of volunteers of Ávila used another banner, white with the cross of Saint Andrew, the arms of the city, two crowned lions and the legend Por Fernando VII.

features.role: Ávila arms — cathedral apse with the boy king on red, inscribed
